statement: There are fixed constants C0, B0, depending only on the fixed analytic action bounds and candidate smallness bounds, for which the following holds. Suppose ∥E(V )∥D1 0 ≤ ε < 1, e−Nδ ≤ ε, Q = 1 + N + δ−1 , where N ≥ 1 is an integer.
